title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Proof of Loss Requirements and Payment Timing
content:
**Requirement.** The insured must send a signed and sworn proof of loss for each coverage claimed under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own).

**Deadline.** A proof of loss is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's proof-of-loss period in calendar days after the date of loss, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, a receipt on the last day qualifying. The date of loss and the received date are read from the claim file.

**Adjuster's report in lieu.** Tidemark may accept the adjuster's report signed and sworn by the insured in lieu of a proof of loss.

**Late proof of loss.** A proof of loss received after the deadline is not accepted and the coverage is denied as proof of loss not timely unless FEMA has issued a written extension of the deadline for the event, recorded on the claim.

**Payment timing.** The loss is payable within the tier's payment period after an accepted proof of loss, or within the tier's payment period after an adjuster's report signed in lieu of it. A payment is never issued for more than the amount sworn on the proof of loss for that coverage.

## Deadline cases (hypothetical; 60-day period from the claim deadlines schedule)

| Date of loss | Proof of loss received | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 30 September (day 60) | yes — the last day qualifies |
| 1 August | 1 October (day 61) | no — denied as not timely unless a FEMA written extension is recorded |
| 1 August | 1 October, FEMA written extension recorded on the claim | the late-filing denial does not apply |
